routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Flights to search. Each route has origin and destination (IATA airport or city codes, e.g. JFK, LHR, NYC) and a date or a dateFrom/dateTo range (one search per day). Dates: YYYY-MM-DD or +N days from today. Round trips: add returnDate or stayDays (nights; works with ranges). Shorthand like "JFK-LHR 2026-11-15" works too.

adults.title: Adults
adults.description: Number of adult passengers (1-9). Prices are the total for all passengers.

maxStops.title: Max stops
maxStops.description: Only return itineraries with at most this many stops.

maxItineraries.title: Max itineraries per search
maxItineraries.description: Stop after this many itineraries for each route and date (Google's order: best flights first, then the rest). Google's results page lists up to ~30 itineraries per search. Each itinerary is one result.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency code for prices, e.g. USD, EUR, GBP, JPY.

country.title: Country
country.description: Point-of-sale country (gl), e.g. US, GB, DE. Prices and availability can differ by country.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language (hl), e.g. en, de, fr. Affects airport and airline names.

onlyNew.title: Only new or changed prices (monitoring)
onlyNew.description: Return only itineraries that are new or whose price changed since an earlier run with the same routes, passengers, cabin, stops, currency and country. Schedule the actor for price alerts: the first run is a baseline, later runs output (and bill) only new or re-priced itineraries. Works best with fixed dates. State is kept in the key-value store "google-flights-prices-state" in your account.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy (datacenter is enough). The actor switches to a new IP whenever Google blocks or rate-limits a request, and falls back to direct requests if the proxy keeps failing.
